verdict_reason: Moving the gates to commodityCode matches the manifest's code-keyed gates, but the package-count rule now has two owners and an untrue counting comment remains.

todos.issue: The package-count rule has two packagesApply functions, both rewritten in this PR, by two different routes: applicability.js:34 reads the numberOfPackages manifest gate (appliesForGateValue), while commodities/consignment-details/fields.js:13 reads commodities.packageCountCommodityCodes() directly. The review page and the consignment-details page can drift if the gate changes (e.g. to code + Latin name).
todos.fix: Must: one function owns whether a line asks for a package count, and both the review rows and the consignment-details page call it. One way: keep the manifest-gate version here (or move it into a shared commodities helper) and have fields.js import it instead of defining its own.

todos.issue: The comment at lines 15-17 says 'The three answers' but four functions follow (destinationCountryApplies, exitDateApplies, portOfExitApplies, transitedCountriesApplies), it carries a count, and it explains rationale and the review UI rather than the lines below.
todos.fix: Must: no comment above these scope-check functions; their names already say what each checks. One way: delete lines 15-17; if the rationale is needed, record it in the behaviour spec.
